**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 03:15
- [USER] User inquired about funding initiatives created by the EU or European banks of development for climate change and energy transition for developing countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Union's Climate Diplomacy Initiative aims to support developing countries in mitigating and adapting to climate change, with EUR 4.7 billion committed between 2014 and 2020.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Investment Bank (EIB) has committed to investing at least 25% of its lending portfolio in climate action projects and has a Green Bond programme for renewable energy and energy efficiency.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has a Green Economy Transition approach, committing over EUR 30 billion in green investments by 2020.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Commission's Clean Energy for All Europeans Package includes funding for clean energy projects in developing countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Global Climate Change Alliance provides EUR 3.4 billion in funding for climate change adaptation and mitigation projects in developing countries between 2014 and 2020.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EIB's Africa Climate-Resilient Infrastructure Financing Facility aims to provide EUR 2 billion in funding for climate-resilient infrastructure projects in Africa between 2018 and 2023.
- [USER] User requested information on recent initiatives launched after 2020.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EIB's Energy Lending Policy, announced in November 2020, focuses on supporting renewable energy and energy efficiency projects, ceasing financing for fossil fuel projects by the end of 2021.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Green Deal, launched in December 2019, includes funding for clean energy projects in developing countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EBRD's Green Cities Programme, launched in 2020, helps cities transition to a low-carbon economy with funding for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Team Europe Initiative, launched in 2020 in response to COVID-19, provides funding for economic recovery and climate change projects in developing countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EIB's Just Transition Fund, launched in 2020, supports regions affected by the transition to a low-carbon economy, focusing on job creation and new industries.
- [USER] User asked for more recent initiatives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The EBRD's Green Innovation Vouchers Programme, launched in 2021, provides funding to SMEs for developing innovative green technologies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Climate Pact, launched in December 2020
